description: conj:e-hartree round 25 (the deep (2,2)=EM push): grounds the core (2,2)=EM channel identification via standard induction, WITHOUT closing the conjecture.  The 2-strand EM coupling is the sign rep of S_2 (e_- singlet, prop:em-coupling-projection); a covalent bond is two such singlets (Pauli-2), i.e. sgn (x) sgn on S_2 x S_2; inducing to S_4 gives (2,2)+(2,1,1)+(1^4) (mult 1 each, verified by Frobenius reciprocity).  (2,2) is the UNIQUE self-transpose summand = the parity-symmetric, antipode-closed bound-state channel, so the covalent EM channel is forced to (2,2); (2,1,1) matches the force-carrier channel (intertwining-correspondence, corroboration only -- it is e-hartree-conditional, not used as input) and (1^4) is the decoupled channel.  ADVANCES the grounding; does NOT close: still rests on the 'covalent = two EM singlets' input + the round-20 alpha^2 algebra + the m_e c^2 CAL-1 unit.  No fit, no experimental number.
